description: Send a reply in a conversation in the user's job seeker inbox. Sending takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is sent, and the reply is a preview of the exact text with a confirm_token; calling again with the same message and that token sends it. The company reads it as coming from the user and it can't be unsent, so show the user the preview and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

confirm_token.description: Leave out to get a preview; nothing is sent. Pass the token from that preview, with the same message, to send it

message.description: The reply, exactly as the user approved it

name: reply_to_message
title: Reply in inbox
